traces.text: The Autotrader used-car platform must cover the following complete functionality: reach the used-car-listing records and actions area through the public entry and primary navigation, verifying that the destination heading and canonical path are visible; execute ClawBench Core task 754 — list a used car for sale on AutoTrader, fill in vehicle details (make, year, mileage, price), and submit the listing, confirming the final review/confirmation view visibly reflects the requested choices and totals; search for vehicles by make/model, location, price, year, mileage, and body style; search for a specific vehicle listing by keyword and refine the results with available filters; sort search results and compare at least two vehicle listings by price, rating, specifications, or availability; open a vehicle listing to inspect photos, specs, mileage, seller/dealer info, price, and history details; select an available option such as size, color, model, quantity, or configuration for a vehicle listing; save a vehicle or search and create a price/new-listing alert; create a new customer account and complete the basic profile/contact setup; sign in to an existing account, verify the account state, and sign out again; contact a seller/dealer or request more information/test drive; add or edit a delivery/pickup address and choose an available shipping/delivery option; create a vehicle-for-sale listing with vehicle details, price, description, and photos, reaching preview/submission; edit, pause, renew, or remove an existing vehicle listing; perform an anonymous search/no-results scenario (search for no matches or apply an impossible filter), verifying a no-results message plus a route back to available used-car-listing records and actions; provide a sign-in entry, verifying the username/email field and available password or identity-provider choices, then return without submitting credentials; provide an account-registration entry, verifying the visible identity fields, terms links, and verification guidance without creating an account; open password recovery from the sign-in surface, verifying the reset-address field, validation guidance, and return-to-sign-in link without sending a reset message; with seeded offline data present, open account history, verifying the newest item exposes its status, detail, edit or cancellation options, and a route back to the relevant collection; open an action with required fields empty or while signed out, verifying inline validation or a permission prompt identifies what must be corrected before continuation; provide a public help/support/contact entry, verifying a user can reach guidance for used-car-listing records and actions, account access, and failed actions without exposing private account data; open a non-existent deep link, verifying a branded not-found or recovery view preserves primary navigation and provides a safe route back to used-car-listing records and actions; starting at the public entry, complete the end-to-end scenario 754.
